skill_metadata.owner: DigiBull AI workflow team; infra owner Harish T.
skill_metadata.supersedes: Per-report JSON + hand-written Python scripts (built by the UltiWeb team), each fed separately to FastMCP
skill_metadata.architecture_note: Stop-gap per the CAM report process deck: ONE manifest -> Jinja2 template -> AST -> FastMCP builds ONE tool for all 16 reports. The same manifest later moves into BAM (pre-tested, pre-certified) unchanged.

isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by a Centum CAM report request for one project (RFQ). Action: load the project's SCRUB BOM, QuoteWin export (AWARDS_PART_NUMBER_LISTING_*_FLOAT_*) and the previous Internal output workbook when it exists, compute the 16 report tabs per the rules in reports[] using the variable values in v_variables, and write one CBOM output workbook. Check: every report's acceptance_checks and the global validation rules pass. Bound: never invent a rule or default; when a variable is unconfirmed, run with the stated fallback and flag it in the run log.

required_inputs: SCRUB BOM workbook for the project (input BOM)
Previous Internal output workbook for the project, when it exists (required for Revision history)
ERP / admin master data: Part table, Top MPNs, supplier master, ERP Data extract
fresh_state_parameters: Project RFQ id and current revision number
Proto / Volume / Batch quantities per FG for this run
Per-project RFQ settings (proto applicability, currencies, price-control source, customer template)
Resolved v_variables values for this run
s_source.per_project_file_register: CAM_Action_Items_Status_Tracker, Report tab rows 33-61: per-project Drive links for SCRUB BOM, QuoteWin, BOM Matrix and Internal workbook, plus which of the 16 tabs exist in each current output.

a_automation.trigger: HTTP POST payload with project_id plus run variables
a_automation.action_step: Resolve request -> load project inputs -> compute the requested report tab(s) from the manifest rules -> render into the CBOM workbook in the exact expected format.
a_automation.acceptance_check: Run the per-report acceptance_checks and global rules; all must pass before the workbook is offered for download (download is gated on completed output, CAM-EC-055).

t_tech_stack.execution_layer: FastMCP (single CAM_Report tool generated from this manifest)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: Pydantic output validator, one schema per report tab, generated from the AST manifest (decoupled from the action tool per ISATVON 1.4)
supporting_services: openpyxl workbook writer (current export classes use Maatwebsite Excel in the Laravel app; the manifest is writer-agnostic)
PostgreSQL JSONB manifest persistence and run log

o_outcome.output_format: One Excel workbook per project run with the 16 tabs named and laid out exactly as in reports[].sheet_name / expected_output.

json_schema.workbook: xlsx, 16 tabs in fixed order R01..R16
json_schema.run_log: JSON: project_id, revision, variable values used, per-tab acceptance results, unconfirmed variables triggered

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: Append-only run log in PostgreSQL (one row per run per tab): iteration evidence, inputs used (file ids + revision), variable values, acceptance result.

ui_updates: Status: Loading inputs -> Computing tab <name> -> Validating -> Completed
Status: Blocked - <unconfirmed variable or missing input> needs confirmation
database_updates: Update project run record and per-tab status in PostgreSQL
alerts: Escalate to the FDE when an unconfirmed variable changes a number the client sees

v_variables._comment: The ISATVON V element, hoisted to top level for readability. Every CAM edge case is a named variable. status: confirmed = backed by a source rule; unconfirmed = reported but never resolved in the sources; conflicting = sources disagree. The generator must expose these per run and must not hard-code values marked unconfirmed.

l1_selection_rule.description: How the L1 (selected) quote is chosen: Award=100 flag vs lowest eligible price. Blank Award blocks output; a zero-price CPN was once selected as L1; ties between two suppliers at the same price need a deterministic priority.
l1_selection_rule.default: Use the Award flag; exclude zero-price and blank-Award rows; flag ties for review
l1_selection_rule.status: unconfirmed - full eligible supplier/price selection rule never confirmed in sources

consolidated_l2_threshold_pct.description: L2 quote acceptable when consolidated pricing is within this % of L1.
consolidated_l2_threshold_pct.status: unconfirmed - historical mail assertion only; denominator and priority vs Award logic unverified

proto_applicability.description: Per-project switch: include Proto prices/quantities in Summary, BOM Matrix, Notes and CBOM, or suppress them. Signata asked for no proto while Lam Node1 needs it; both behaviors are correct per project.
proto_applicability.status: confirmed as project-specific; per-project values live in project settings

proto_batch_default_qty.description: Default quantity when Proto or batch quantity is unspecified in input.
proto_batch_default_qty.default: none - block and ask rather than invent a quantity

qty_propagation.description: Edits to quantities (incl. fractional packing: Master Carton 0.2, Pallet 0.0125), prices, lead times, NRE and price-control categories in any working tab must recompute every dependent tab before output. The recurring Sept-Oct defects were all propagation failures.
qty_propagation.default: recompute all dependent tabs from current working data on any edit

sum_count_basis.description: Sum = part quantity; Count = CPN occurrences; box/packing units are a separate input. A row is flagged red only on a genuine difference.
sum_count_basis.status: partially clarified in sources; box-quantity input location unverified

scrap_factor_rule.description: Scrap percent and scrap factor per ABC class (historical proposal: A/B/C = 1%/2%/5%); whether the factor is whole-number or decimal.
scrap_factor_rule.status: unconfirmed - rounding and thresholds never settled in sources

eau_split_basis.description: EAU per volume and Extended Volume split computation; repeated MPN across FGs sums FG qty x part qty; handle VL1 price present with no VL2 price.

moq_spq_turns_rule.description: Excess/MOQ math: MOQ + n x SPQ to reach volume; turns = 1 + n; average-days column optional.

currency_set.description: Currencies processed. Sources show only INR/USD/EUR handled; a blank Original Currency blocks conversion; currency symbols must be displayed on price columns.
currency_set.status: unconfirmed beyond the three; exception list needed

ncnr_flag_rules.description: NCNR carried from QuoteWin into Missing Notes; NCNR count must match QW; non-NCNR rows show NO; NFRND flag present.

mpn_mfr_match_rules.description: CPN/MPN matching normalization (case and suffix variants, e.g. 1360394889_Serv vs _SERV lost 37 priced parts); MFR source priority (Scrub vs internal DB vs QuoteWin); a corrected MPN equal to the original is not flagged; duplicate-MPN and multi-CPN note rules; edits refresh match flags.
mpn_mfr_match_rules.default: match on normalized MPN; MFR from Scrub unless a per-project source policy says otherwise
mpn_mfr_match_rules.status: unconfirmed - normalization and MFR source priority never settled

parent_subassembly_costing.description: Build-vs-buy without double counting: a price on the parent must not also be costed on the subassembly; assembly prices stay out of direct-price L/M columns; assembly level numbering ordered and hierarchical; duplicate FG pairs counted once, different FGs summed.
parent_subassembly_costing.status: design confirmed historically; current implementation unverified

revision_history_scope.description: Revision history must cover existing projects with prior Internal workbooks, not only new projects.
revision_history_scope.default: compute when a previous Internal workbook exists; otherwise tab states 'first run'

quote_validity_min_days.description: Minimum quote validity. One source asks 30 days, another a 3-month guideline.
quote_validity_min_days.default: none - do not silently extend commercial terms
quote_validity_min_days.status: conflicting - governing threshold must be confirmed before validation

decimal_precision.description: Display precision: July MOM asks Summary at 2 decimals; a Nov plan says display 2, backend 6.

validation_error_highlighting.description: Validation Summary must highlight the actual errored cells/rows in red, not only show counts; an errored BOM must never display OK.

uncosted_handling.description: Costed parts must not be labelled uncosted; uncosted line items still count toward line-item totals matching Scrub.

input_validation_rules.description: Reject or flag, with a clear reason: empty Scrub (zero FG/MPN/CPN counts must not look like a successful run), missing QW original prices, project-name mismatch between files, unsupported template headers (aliases like MOQs vs MOQ, Vols vs Vol), and valid xlsx rejected as wrong file type.
input_validation_rules.default: validate inputs before compute; report exact failing file and field

quotewin_size_cap_rows.description: Maximum QuoteWin size the pipeline accepts. A ~20k-row QW (CE-005657 Thales SharpView) exceeded the cap and no Matrix was produced.
quotewin_size_cap_rows.default: unknown - confirm the current cap and safe handling

performance_sla.description: Processing time bound. A 691-unique-CPN run took 16 minutes; uploads sometimes stall with no output and no error.
performance_sla.default: none agreed - expose processing state and agree a measurable SLA

download_gating.description: Workbook download is offered only after all 16 tabs computed and validated; a download button during calculation and ChunkLoadError failures are known defects. Historical note: download requires all 16 reports.
download_gating.default: gate download on completed, validated output

freshness_90day_rule.description: Reuse-cost freshness: for costs under 90 days, choose between skipping the RFQ, sending with an L1 note, or an Old Cost column.
freshness_90day_rule.default: none - the Feb attachment marks 'email supplier with L1 note', not verified as adopted

supplier_terms_default.description: Default payment terms when the supplier DB has none for a supplier.
supplier_terms_default.default: none - use verified terms or an approved default

nre_grouping.description: NRE charge basis: L1 MPNs with NRE grouped PCB vs Mechanical/ElectroMechanical; NRE edits propagate downstream.

commodity_c1_c2_lookup.description: C1/C2 commodity categories across SMTP and Scrub: high-level vs subtype lookup.
commodity_c1_c2_lookup.default: align to the Nov-24 confirmed taxonomy
commodity_c1_c2_lookup.status: historical alignment confirmed; current data unverified

batch_scope.description: Batch is a third tab (confirmed May-2); batch input is not supplier-visible; assembly vs MPN level scope.

manual_price_source_policy.description: Whether prices received manually or by email (beyond the QuoteWin file) are included in the compared output.
manual_price_source_policy.default: QuoteWin only, unless a per-project input register says otherwise

demo_output_labeling.description: A filename-matched prebuilt/simulated output must be labelled as demo and never counted as computed validation.

rfq_routing_zero_mpn.description: When all sourcing is third-party and no MPNs route to CAMail, define the real sourcing path; label any simulated quotes.

settings_bulk_upload.description: Per-project RFQ settings accept a bulk upload instead of per-project entry.
settings_bulk_upload.status: internal implementation reported; customer validation unverified

volume_wise_costing_input.description: Support a volume-wise costing input sheet (requested 9-Sep; costing noted as second priority 24-Sep).
volume_wise_costing_input.status: in progress - not a settled rule

cbom_acceptance_checklist.description: CBOM acceptance rules from the Centum checklist: revision number in the CBOM name; Sourcing Manager review on all CBOMs; SCM Head review at $3M+ and must-win; material assumptions stated; LTB date on all EOL/discontinued parts; MCL raised dates; header/status matches the agreed Centum template; excess aligned with assembly analysis.
